kind: deterministic contract fixture scenarios; not observed model or product acceptance

cases.name: same_report_same_text_new_callback_id
cases.expected: original reply ID and sequence; one turn

cases.name: foreign_or_forged_or_noncanonical_report
cases.expected: error; no reply and no Owner lifecycle or Goal/Work mutation

cases.name: active_owner_report_admission
cases.expected: durably queued in same canonical conversation, not direct SDK interleaving; report has no Owner turn capability

cases.name: previously_done_sdk_report
cases.expected: recover original request/submission/entry identity, project once; zero new model/worker requests

cases.name: lost_projection_ack
cases.expected: inspect current report; recover original reply identity or replay exact original callback; never replace text or choose a new model invocation

cases.name: private_notification
cases.expected: strongest private disclosure, existing guarded local model only; no external model fallback
